title: potentilla lycopodioides var. scandularis
intro: Potentilla lycopodioides var. scandularis, commonly known as Chinese Five-Leaf Clover, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family that is native to China. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and improve digestion. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which make it useful in treating various conditions such as sore throats and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla lycopodioides var. scandularis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
